metadata.description: Claude plugins for Indian finance, accounts and listed-company compliance

plugins.name: listed-company-cfo
plugins.description: SEBI LODR disclosure desk, results-day checklist, IPO offer document review, annual report review and review markup for NSE / BSE listed companies

plugins.name: financial-reporting
plugins.description: Trial balance to audit-ready financial statements (Ind AS, AS, IFRS, US GAAP) and Ind AS 116 lease accounting with the IGAAP bridge

plugins.name: finance-operations
plugins.description: Indian F&A close: GSTR-2B ITC reconciliation, TDS audit, MSME 43B(h), bank reconciliation, trial balance close gate, budget vs actual, receivables ECL, journal entry testing

plugins.name: debt-and-treasury
plugins.description: CMA data and MPBF for bank loans, NCD interest registers with TDS, DSCR, covenant monitoring and credit rating preparation
